name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: A national initiative aimed at improving child sex ratio and promoting education for girls through awareness campaigns and community programs.

eligibility.notes: Implementation varies by district; mainly focused on girl child welfare and education awareness.

benefits: Awareness campaigns promoting girl child education
Support for education and social upliftment initiatives
Improved access to education programs
applicationProcess: No single national application form. Implemented through district/state programs.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: A savings scheme for the girl child that helps parents build funds for education and marriage.

eligibility.notes: Account can be opened by parents/guardians in Post Office or authorized banks.

benefits: High interest savings account
Tax benefits under Section 80C
Funds can be used for education expenses after age 18
applicationProcess: Apply at a Post Office or authorized bank with birth certificate and ID proof.

name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education (NSIGSE)
description: Provides financial incentive to encourage girls to enroll and continue education at the secondary level, especially from disadvantaged backgrounds.

eligibility.notes: Girl must be enrolled in government/local body schools.

benefits: Cash incentive deposited in a bank account
Encourages continuation of secondary education
applicationProcess: Apply through school or state education department process.

name: CBSE Udaan Scheme for Girls
description: A CBSE initiative to support girls in pursuing engineering and technical education through mentoring and learning resources.

eligibility.notes: Students must be enrolled in CBSE-affiliated schools.

benefits: Free online learning resources
Study material and mentorship support
Preparation assistance for engineering entrance exams
applicationProcess: Apply through CBSE portal when application window opens.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: Scholarship scheme for meritorious students to support higher education at undergraduate and postgraduate levels.

eligibility.education: Passed Class XII with high merit
eligibility.notes: Merit-based scholarship with limited slots per state.

benefits: Annual scholarship amount for graduation/post-graduation
Encourages continuation of higher education

name: PRAGATI Scholarship for Girl Students (AICTE)
description: Scholarship for girls pursuing technical education such as engineering, pharmacy, or diploma courses.

eligibility.notes: Only for students admitted to AICTE-approved institutions.

benefits: Scholarship up to ₹50,000 per year
Covers tuition fees, books, laptop, and educational expenses

name: Indira Gandhi PG Scholarship for Single Girl Child
description: Supports postgraduate education for single girl child to encourage higher studies.
benefits: Monthly scholarship support during PG studies
Encourages women participation in higher education
applicationProcess: Apply through UGC portal when applications open.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
description: Encourages talented students, including women, to pursue science courses at undergraduate level.

eligibility.notes: Merit-based; based on performance in Class XII or entrance exams.

benefits: Scholarship amount for higher education in science
Research mentorship and encouragement for STEM careers
applicationProcess: Apply through INSPIRE portal during application cycle.

name: Mahila Samakhya Programme
description: A programme focused on women's literacy and empowerment through education and awareness in rural areas.

eligibility.notes: Primarily for rural and disadvantaged women and adolescent girls.

benefits: Literacy programs and awareness initiatives
Community empowerment groups
Support for continuing education
applicationProcess: Implemented through state government and local organizations.

name: Lakhpati Bitiya Scheme (Delhi)
description: A state-level scheme providing savings support for girl children to promote education and future security.

eligibility.notes: Eligibility depends on Delhi government rules and income criteria.

benefits: Government deposits for girl child
Financial support for education and future needs
applicationProcess: Apply through Delhi government welfare portal or local offices.

name: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana (Jharkhand)
description: A scheme aimed at reducing dropout rates among girls by providing financial support for education from middle school to senior secondary.

eligibility.notes: Eligibility depends on Jharkhand government enrollment requirements.

benefits: Direct financial aid for education continuation
Support to reduce child marriage and dropout
applicationProcess: Apply through Jharkhand government education portal or school-based enrollment system.
